title: Opulent Chest
summary: Portable container that can be picked up or thrown.

fields.Storage: Holds inventory items. Found as set dressing or loot, with contents that vary by location.
fields.Durability: 50 HP and Medium Toughness. Each individual hit must deal at least 22 damage to harm it.
fields.Damage affinities: Resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning. Immune to Poison and Psychic.
